content_zh:
第九章 高军的反思
感谢书友“不想下马”、“落井就要下石”和“我对本书读后感”的打赏，顺便求一下推荐票和会员点击，毕竟是新书期^_^
“毛主席说过，没有知识的军队是愚蠢的军队，同样，没有知识的球队也是愚蠢的球队，你现在还小，不能只顾着练球，至少也得给我把初中给毕业了。虽然你不出意外的话，应该肯定可以成为职业球员，但是有些文化底子对你领会战术要求也是很有帮助的。而且你将来肯定要出国踢球的，所以外语也必须学好。”，徐指导对高军认真地说道。
没法解释自己上过初中的高军只得无奈地在基地与初中两头跑，并轻松地在一年半（高军是2000年11月加入基地的）的时间内提前毕业，惊得徐指导目瞪口呆。由于学历本身对于优秀球员来说意义不大，拿到初中文凭后，徐指导就没有要求高军继续读下去，但还是要求他尽量利用闲暇时间学习外语，这却是十分有用的。
对运动员来说，普通教育学到初中掌握自学能力就行了，以后有需要可以自己学，只要好学上进，一样有可能具备很高的文化程度。而且作为过来人，高军很清楚文化知识对提高球员思维能力的帮助其实远不像媒体宣扬的那么夸张。
在高军看来，所谓的“中国球员不会动脑子是因为受教育程度低”的说法其实是倒果为因，事实上，由于中国“万般皆下品，惟有读书高。”的传统、导致聪明的孩子都被家长逼着读书去了，往往只有那些读书不行的人才会选择当运动员，所以实际上是中国球员大多不会动脑子，所以受教育程度普遍不高，而不是相反......
这一年多的时间里相对平静，高军正好充分利用这段时间适应自己新的身份和人际关系，虽然仍未息了去找这个时空的自己和亲人的念头，但已经不像一开始那样一直萦绕心中了。此外，高军还对自己穿越前的教练生涯进行了一番回顾和总结，虽然现在的高军年纪还小，之后很多年里都只可能以球员的身份出现，但是教练水平的提高对于踢球时
虽然很多球迷认为高军当年执教国家队时踢的是技术流的控球打法，但是高军自己却很清楚，自己比较成功的几次执教经历其实都是靠的防反取得了佳绩，只是这种防反在进入前场30米区域之前会尽量选择从地面过渡，而不是直接后场起大脚碰运气，在不懂行的球迷看来很像是华丽的控球打法罢了。而且一旦遇到对方凶狠的逼抢，传递立刻就会变得不畅起来，失误也会明显增多，因此充其量只能说是伪技术流......
不过，这种伪技术流防反战术虽然问题很多，但相较盲目压上狂攻的打法，能够节约不少体能，这对于体能普遍不好的中国球队有着特殊的意义。
而且，高军在国内教练里堪称第一的整体防守战术水平令国家队的防守能力，准确地说、是防线回收状态下的防守能力大幅改善，这从热身赛上中国二队能在客场顶住法国队的全场猛攻，就可见一斑。
事实上高军当年执教中国队时最大的进步就是想守住的时候一般都能守住了，即使双方实力差距悬殊。当然，如果对方有球员依靠个人天才和瞬间灵感打出世界波或者一条龙的突破，那还是没有办法的，好在至少在亚洲级别的比赛中，这种情况并不会经常遇到......
除了整体防守，高军当年的技术流地面反击也是国内一绝，当年他所执教的国家队因此反击特别犀利，在前场没有一个亚洲一流球星的情况下，能够让32年没赢过的韩国队在一场比赛中连吞3弹就是很好的证明，毕竟哪怕只是半主力阵容的韩国队，此前的中国队也从未赢过。
然而，防反再华丽那也是防反，其固有的缺陷依然存在，首先，如果对方也玩防反，那就只能跟其比耐心了，而一旦遇到率先丢球、碰上弱旅之类的情况必须主动压上进攻，那就会同时暴露出后防漏风和攻坚不力这两个致命的问题，不但很难扳回比分，压上进攻时还很容易被对方的反击干掉......
先说后防漏风的问题，整体防守战术固然可以在很大程度上弥补中国后卫个人能力的不足，但却并不是万能的。如果防线收缩，防守球员具有人数上的优势，那么情况还好。可一旦中国队压上进攻，后防留给对方的空间增大，防守体系的篱笆就会变得漏洞百出，而中国后卫的单防能力不足和容易走神的弱点就会暴露无遗，当初高军执教中国队的最后两场比赛居然被老挝这种级别的球队利用反击多次破门，就是最好的证明......
不过这个问题其实是一个世界性的难题，只有宇宙队时期的巴萨利用超强的控球能力和不惜体力的前场反抢尽可能地降低了对方打反击的机会，才有效地减轻了敌人反击的威胁。但即使是这种战术玩得最好的巴萨，对方的反击、甚至是正面进攻也不会绝对打不出来，如果把握机会能力好一点，依然足以致命。
后来巴萨被拜仁两场比赛狂灌7个球，就足以说明巴萨的这种战术并不完美，一旦碰上整体实力不弱于自己、甚至更强的对手，一样可能变得漏洞百出。何况中国即使在亚洲范围内都算不上强队，论个人能力，顶多只能算是亚洲二流的中游水平，又根本没有保证前场逼抢力度的充沛体能，球员的个人传接球技术和配合的默契程度也并不怎么样，因此这个问题就更难解决了，直到高军穿越前的那一刻，这依然困扰着他。
而对方密集防守时攻坚不力的问题，则更是令人头痛，这不光是对方人员密集减少了己方的射门机会那么简单，还由于压上进攻时对方禁区里到处是人，空间受到严重挤压，可供球员做动作的时间会比反击时短很多，稍微拖沓一下、进攻机会就会被对方的球员破坏掉。

Chapter 9 Gao Jun’s reflection
Thanks to the book friends "I don't want to get off my horse", "If I fall into a well, I will add another stone to the stone" and "My feelings after reading this book". By the way, I would like to ask for recommendation votes and member clicks. After all, it is a new book issue^_^
"Chairman Mao said that an army without knowledge is a stupid army. Similarly, a team without knowledge is also a stupid team. You are still young and cannot just focus on practicing football. You must at least graduate from junior high school. Although if nothing happens to you, you should definitely be able to become a professional player, but some cultural background is also very helpful for you to understand the tactical requirements. And you will definitely go abroad to play football in the future, so you must also learn foreign languages well." Director Xu said seriously to Gao Jun.
Gao Jun, who could not explain that he had gone to junior high school, had no choice but to run between the base and the junior high school, and easily graduated early in one and a half years (Gao Jun joined the base in November 2000), which shocked Director Xu. Since the academic qualification itself is of little significance to outstanding players, after receiving the junior high school diploma, Director Xu did not ask Gao Jun to continue studying, but still asked him to use his free time to learn foreign languages ​​as much as possible, which was very useful.
For athletes, it is enough to master self-study skills from general education to junior high school. If necessary, they can learn on their own in the future. As long as they are studious and motivated, it is possible to achieve a high level of education. And as someone who has experienced it, Gao Jun knows very well that the help of cultural knowledge in improving players' thinking ability is actually far less exaggerated than what the media promotes.
In Gao Jun's view, the so-called "Chinese players can't use their brains because they have low education" is actually the opposite of the cause. In fact, due to China's tradition of "everything is low-grade, only reading is high", smart children are forced to study by their parents. Often only those who can't study will choose to be athletes. So in fact, most Chinese players can't use their brains, so their education level is generally not high, not the other way around...
The past year or so has been relatively peaceful, and Gao Jun has made full use of this time to adapt to his new identity and interpersonal relationships. Although he still has the thought of finding himself and his relatives in this time and space, it is no longer as lingering in his mind as it was at the beginning. In addition, Gao Jun also reviewed and summarized his coaching career before time travel. Although Gao Jun is still young now and will only be able to appear as a player for many years to come, the improvement of coaching level will have a great impact on playing football.
Although many fans think that when Gao Jun coached the national team, he played a technical ball-control style, Gao Jun himself knows very well that his more successful coaching experiences were actually achieved by relying on counter-attacks. However, this kind of counter-attacks will try to transition from the ground before entering the 30-meter area in the front court, rather than directly starting from the backcourt to try his luck. In the eyes of uninformed fans, it looks like a gorgeous ball-control style. And once you encounter the opponent's fierce pressing, the passing will immediately become sluggish, and the number of mistakes will increase significantly. Therefore, it can only be said to be pseudo-technical flow at best...
However, although this kind of pseudo-technical defense and counter-attack tactics has many problems, it can save a lot of physical energy compared to the blind attack style, which is of special significance to Chinese teams whose physical fitness is generally poor.
Moreover, Gao Jun's overall defensive tactics level, which is ranked first among domestic coaches, has greatly improved the national team's defensive ability, to be precise, the defensive ability when the defense line is retracted. This can be seen from the fact that the Chinese second team was able to withstand the French team's full-court attack in the away game in the warm-up match.
In fact, Gao Jun's biggest improvement when he coached the Chinese team was that he could usually hold on when he wanted to, even if the strength gap between the two sides was huge. Of course, if there are players on the other side who rely on personal genius and instant inspiration to create a world wave or a one-stop breakthrough, there is still no way.Fortunately, at least at the Asian level, this situation does not happen often...
In addition to the overall defense, Gao Jun's technical ground counterattacks were also unique in the country. The national team he coached at that time counterattacked particularly sharply. Without a first-class Asian star in the frontcourt, it is a good proof that the Korean team, which has not won in 32 years, swallowed three bombs in a game. After all, even if the Korean team only has a semi-main lineup, the Chinese team has never won before.
However, no matter how gorgeous the counterattack is, it is still counterattack, and its inherent flaws still exist. First of all, if the opponent also plays counterattack, you can only be patient with them. Once you encounter the situation of losing the ball first, encountering a weak team, etc., you must take the initiative to attack, which will simultaneously expose the two fatal problems of back leakage and weak attack. Not only is it difficult to regain the score, but it is also easy to be killed by the opponent's counterattack when pressing the attack...
Let’s talk about the issue of rear defense first. Although the overall defensive tactics can make up for the lack of personal ability of the Chinese defenders to a large extent, they are not omnipotent. If the defense shrinks and the defenders have a numerical advantage, then things are fine. But once the Chinese team attacks and the defense leaves more space for the opponent, the defensive system's fence will become full of holes, and the Chinese defender's lack of individual defense ability and the weakness of being easily distracted will be fully exposed. In the last two games when Gao Jun coached the Chinese team, a team of Laos' level used counterattacks to score multiple goals, which is the best proof...
However, this problem is actually a worldwide problem. Only during the Cosmos era, Barcelona used its superior ball control ability and physical counter-attacks in the frontcourt to reduce the opponent's chance of counterattack as much as possible, thus effectively reducing the threat of the enemy's counterattack. But even if Barcelona is the best at this tactic, the opponent's counterattacks and even frontal attacks will not be absolutely impossible. If they can seize opportunities better, they can still be fatal.
Later, Barcelona was given 7 goals by Bayern in two games, which is enough to show that Barcelona's tactics are not perfect. Once they encounter an opponent whose overall strength is not weaker than itself, or even stronger, it may become full of loopholes. What's more, China is not even considered a strong team in Asia. In terms of personal ability, it can only be regarded as the second-rate mid-level level in Asia. It also does not have sufficient physical fitness to ensure the intensity of the frontcourt press. The players' personal passing and receiving skills and tacit understanding of cooperation are not very good. Therefore, this problem is even more difficult to solve. Until the moment before Gao Jun crossed over, this still bothered him.
The problem of inability to attack when the opponent is densely defending is even more troublesome. This is not only because the opponent's dense personnel reduces one's own shooting opportunities, but also because when the opponent presses the attack, there are people everywhere in the opponent's penalty area, and the space is severely squeezed. The time available for players to make actions will be much shorter than during counterattack. If there is a slight delay, the offensive opportunity will be destroyed by the opponent's players.
